### [Claude Sonnet 5.5](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/28/claude-sonnet-5-5/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-09-28

Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, which runs over 30% faster, costs up to 30% less for most tasks, and replaces older models on claude.ai's free tier.

- Sonnet 5.5 runs 30%+ faster and reduces costs by up to 30% compared to previous workloads while outperforming Sonnet 5 across benchmarks.
- The model exhibits a bug at 'max' thinking effort, where it consumes 128,000 tokens ($1.28) before failing without outputting a result.
- On an 'xhigh' thinking effort setting, the model generated a WebGL pelican SVG in 41 seconds at a cost of 5.74 cents.
- Sonnet 5.5 matches Opus 5.5 performance on certain coding tasks, including 3D animation rendering.
- Anthropic made Sonnet 5.5 the default model for its free tier on claude.ai and announced Haiku 5.5 will launch in the coming weeks.

**Why it matters:** Sonnet 5.5 delivers near-Opus level coding capabilities at lower latency and cost, providing a significantly more capable free-tier AI model than competing offerings like ChatGPT's Luna 5.6.

`anthropic` `claude` `llms` `ai-benchmarks`
